paper2Questions.questionText: Read the passage carefully. Answer the questions that follow. Passage 1.

subparts.question: Give one reason why the learners initially avoided the library.
State two actions taken by the new librarian.
What evidence shows that the changes were successful?
Give a suitable title for the passage.

paper2Questions.passage: The school library had been neglected for several years. Books were dusty, some shelves were broken and many learners preferred to spend their free time outside. A new librarian decided to change the situation. She organised the books, repaired the shelves with the help of the school maintenance team and started a reading club. Within a few months, learners were borrowing books regularly and discussing stories during break time.

paper2Questions.questionText: Read the passage carefully. Answer the questions that follow. Passage 2.

subparts.question: Give one reason why the learners initially avoided the library.
State two actions taken by the new librarian.
What evidence shows that the changes were successful?
Give a suitable title for the passage.

paper2Questions.passage: When the first rains arrived, the villagers prepared their fields. Some repaired contour ridges while others collected manure for their gardens. The headman encouraged families to conserve water and protect nearby trees. He explained that careful use of natural resources would help both present and future generations.

paper2Questions.passage: At the bus terminus, a young boy noticed an elderly passenger struggling with several bags. He offered to carry one of them to the waiting area. The passenger thanked him and reminded the boy that small acts of kindness can make a difficult day easier.
